dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm making a bucket list before I leave. Do you want to help?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə ˈbʌkɪt ˌlɪst bɪˈfɔːr aɪ ˈliːv. duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈhɛlp?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Number one: ride in a hot-air balloon over Chiang Mai. I've dreamed of doing that for years.
dialogue.reading: ˈnʌmbər ˈwʌn: ˈraɪd ɪn ə ˌhɑːt ˈɛr bəˌluːn ˈoʊvər ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ. aɪv ˈdriːmd əv ˈduːɪŋ ˈðæt fər ˈjɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That sounds amazing. I'm thinking about trying skydiving one day.
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz əˈmeɪzɪŋ. aɪm ˈθɪŋkɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈtraɪɪŋ ˈskaɪdaɪvɪŋ ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Skydiving? But you're afraid of heights!
dialogue.reading: ˈskaɪdaɪvɪŋ? bʌt jʊr əˈfreɪd əv ˈhaɪts!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know! That's why it's on my list. What else is on yours?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ! ðæts ˈwaɪ ɪts ɑːn maɪ ˈlɪst. ˈwʌt ˈɛls ɪz ɑːn ˈjʊrz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Learning to sail. My grandfather owns a small boat in Canada.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɜːrnɪŋ tə ˈseɪl. maɪ ˈɡrænfɑːðər ˈoʊnz ə ˈsmɔːl ˈboʊt ɪn ˈkænədə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Cool! I dream of owning a little café one day.
dialogue.reading: ˈkuːl! aɪ ˈdriːm əv ˈoʊnɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl kæˈfeɪ ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Put it on your list! And let's add one more thing together.
dialogue.reading: ˈpʊt ɪt ɑːn jʊr ˈlɪst! ənd lɛts ˈæd ˈwʌn ˈmɔːr ˈθɪŋ təˈɡɛðər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Seeing each other again, every year!
dialogue.reading: ˈsiːɪŋ ˈiːtʃ ˈʌðər əˈɡɛn, ˈɛvri ˈjɪr!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK! And I insist on paying for our first dinner.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ənd aɪ ɪnˈsɪst ɑːn ˈpeɪɪŋ fər aʊər ˈfɜːrst ˈdɪnər.
